visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a red sweater under a blue and white paneled jacket walks nervously outside a building with ivy-covered walls. He looks down and shifts his weight while speaking. (2) The scene cuts to a montage of vintage Japanese magazines (Animage) displayed on walls and in glass cases, followed by movie posters for 'Porco Rosso,' 'Spirited Away,' and 'The Cat Returns' overlaid on screen. (3) The man enters a bright indoor exhibition hall and shakes hands with an older man in a dark suit and glasses. They walk together past various framed animation sketches and storyboards. (4) The two men stand in front of a wall covered in magazine covers, engaging in a formal interview. The older man gestures as he explains the artwork. (5) Close-up shots show detailed pencil sketches and hand-painted animation cels on a table. The young man nods and listens intently. (6) Finally, the young man stands in front of a large-scale model of a creature from Nausicaä, gesturing broadly as he addresses the camera in a brightly lit gallery space.
